name: cortico-world-slim
description: 给大肥鱼用的上下文瘦身包：把工作区里越堆越厚的交接笔记折成一份摘要，旧笔记移到工作区外的归档目录，每轮自动维护——少读原文，少花 token。Fold ever-growing handoff notes into one digest and archive the old ones outside the workspace.

zh.description: 把工作区里越堆越厚的交接笔记折成一份摘要，旧笔记移出工作区归档；每轮对话后自动检查，读摘要就能接上之前的事，不必把旧笔记原文再读一遍。

en.description: Folds the ever-growing handoff notes in the workspace into one digest, archives the old ones outside the workspace, and keeps it current after every turn — so catching up costs a short read instead of the whole pile.

author: LFY-sys
